data.gender_notes: Cletus is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'kleos', meaning 'glory', and 'selene', the name of the Greek goddess of the moon. In Christian tradition, Cletus is known as a disciple of St. Peter and a bishop in ancient Rome. The name Cletus carries the meaning “Glory of the Moon” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cletus usually hope their child will grow to embody glory of the moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cletus total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
